item.title: Let's Build the World Wise Web
item.description: A decade has now passed since the emergence of the Intellectual Dark Web (IDW). Figureheads like Jordan Peterson, Sam Harris and Eric Weinstein used their dizzying intellects to eloquently diagnose the deeper systemic issues with modern society. The problem was, raw intelligence is excellent at diagnosis and terrible at prescription.

item.title: A Blueprint for the Future
item.description: “No more prizes for predicting the rain, only prizes for building the arks” -Don Beck I founded The Leading Edge because I am more optimistic about the prospects for World Wise Web (WWW) networks than any trend I’ve seen in my life. Running it has made me extravagantly happy
